# Wholesale eligibility

Wholesale pricing is available for orders of at least 100 units of the same SKU. Units from similar products cannot be combined to reach the threshold: for example, AUR-100 and AUR-100B remain separate SKUs. A wholesale quote is valid only when issued by the wholesale team and does not reserve inventory until the required deposit is confirmed.

## Deposit and notice

Approved wholesale orders require a 50 percent deposit and seven calendar days notice before the requested dispatch date. The remaining balance is due before dispatch. A bank-transfer screenshot does not replace confirmed settlement. A failed bank transfer does not reserve stock, including for a wholesale order.

## Price and promotion exclusions

Wholesale pricing cannot be combined with WELCOME10, HOMEWEEKEND, staff pricing, reward-point redemptions, or any other checkout promotion. Wholesale customers may receive a delivery quote, but standard free-delivery thresholds for retail checkout do not automatically apply. Delivery timing depends on the approved dispatch date and carrier arrangement.

## Changes and cancellations

Changes to a wholesale order must be approved before purchasing begins. A cancellation request may be subject to supplier commitments already made for the order. These terms do not replace the retail refund policy for a completed consumer order, and they do not provide a customer-service promise for a specific bank credit date.

## Quote validation

A wholesale quote must identify the same SKU, unit quantity, requested dispatch date, and customer business before it can be treated as an approved quote. A large total value does not by itself make a retail order wholesale eligible. Similarly, a group of adjacent product variants cannot be added together merely because they have similar names. The wholesale team, rather than checkout, confirms whether the threshold, deposit, and notice requirements have been met. Until confirmation, no inventory or price should be promised.

## Boundaries for support

These terms are limited to approved wholesale orders. They do not create retail free delivery, modify a promotion code, decide whether a card payment settled, or say when a consumer refund will arrive. If a question covers both a retail policy and wholesale terms, support should keep the answers separate and cite the relevant source for each. A supplier commitment can affect a cancellation review, but it is not an automatic cancellation refusal. Any individual exception requires its own recorded approval.

The wholesale team keeps its approval record with the quote so later support requests can be checked against the exact SKU, quantity, and requested dispatch arrangement.
